criterion: Error messages / feedback: clear error indication
description: The Control pane's error banner is wiped by the next successful 2 s poll. A rejected pairing code ("T3 sign-in failed with HTTP 400") stays visible for about 1–2.5 s, and an unreachable T3 address ("fetch failed") for under 1 s. After that the form looks exactly as before the click.
expected: An action error persists until the person edits the field, retries or dismisses it, and is shown next to the T3 credential form.
actual: The error appears at the top of the pane and vanishes on the next poll. A screenshot 3 s after the click shows no error.
suggested_fix: Keep action errors separate from poll errors: store them per form and clear them only on the next submit or edit of that form, not when a poll succeeds.

description: Pairing errors are raw transport text. A wrong pairing code shows "T3 sign-in failed with HTTP 400", and an unreachable address returns HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR "fetch failed" rather than a T3 transport code.
expected: "T3 did not accept that pairing code: check it and try again" and "Nothing answered at http://127.0.0.1:3780: is T3 running on that address?"
actual: "T3 sign-in failed with HTTP 400" / "fetch failed" (500 INTERNAL_ERROR).
suggested_fix: Map `pairing_rejected` to a code-specific message, and map connection failures to T3_BUSY/T3_UNKNOWN with the address in the text.

description: A successful pairing is signalled only by the word "missing" changing to "valid" in a 13 px status sentence and the button relabelling to "Pair again".
expected: A visible confirmation such as "Paired with T3 0.1.6 · expires 12/9/2026" near the form, or a status badge.
actual: Only a small change inside the status sentence.
suggested_fix: Show the credential state as a badge (Missing / Valid / Expiring) next to the T3 credential heading.
